tagged_by: manual reading (assistant); a model judging labels, not ground truth

tag_definitions.MISLABEL: no offense discernible in the text; the gold OFF label looks wrong
tag_definitions.IMPLICIT: genuine offense carrying no profanity token - insult by metaphor, sarcasm, mockery, threat, sexual solicitation, group-directed hate
tag_definitions.EVASION: profanity present but obfuscated, abbreviated, or non-Turkish, so the frozen lexicon missed it
tag_definitions.AMBIG: cannot be ruled without the team's annotation convention - includes the political / institutional-criticism band, left untouched by instruction

top60_by_confidence.description: the 60 most confidently-wrong false negatives (lowest p_OFF). BIASED sample: sorting by confidence selects for label noise, so its mislabel rate is an upper bound, not an estimate of the slice.

random40_of_247_lexicon_free.description: UNBIASED sample: 40 drawn with random.Random(42).sample() from the 247 lexicon-free false negatives. This is the defensible estimate of the slice's annotation-noise rate.

headline: Day 1's ~30-35% annotation-noise estimate was inflated by confidence-sorting bias. The defensible figure is ~10%. The dominant mode is genuine implicit offense, not label noise.

checkpoint_stability.conclusion: checkpoint disagreement is a decision-boundary phenomenon; none of the confidently-wrong failures this analysis rests on are checkpoint-specific
